one_liner_zh: 萬事達EPS小幅超預期，營收年增近16%顯示跨境消費與支付量持續強勁。
one_liner_en: Mastercard modestly beat EPS with ~16% revenue growth, reflecting resilient cross-border and payment volumes.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期1.34%，營收年增15.83%反映消費動能穩健。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正面但溫和：EPS與營收雙超預期，年增近16%顯示支付網路在高基期下仍具韌性。短中期股價有基本面支撑，惟28倍本益比已反映多數樂觀預期，上檔需靠跨境交易與新服務（數據分析、附加價值服務）持續加速。追蹤指標：跨境交易量年增率、營業利潤率、附加價值服務營收占比，以及全球消費景氣與監管動向。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive but moderate: a double beat with ~16% growth shows the network's resilience against a high base. Near/mid-term the stock has fundamental support, but a 28x P/E already prices in much optimism; upside depends on continued acceleration in cross-border volumes and value-added services. Track: cross-border volume growth, operating margin, value-added services revenue mix, and global consumer/regulatory trends.
highlights_zh: EPS 4.35美元，超出預期4.29美元，超預期幅度1.34%
營收84.0億美元，年增15.83%，成長動能優於支付同業平均
跨境交易與消費支出持續為核心成長引擎
本益比28.38倍，反映市場給予支付網路龍頭的溢價
highlights_en: EPS of $4.35 beat the $4.29 estimate by 1.34%
Revenue of $8.40B grew 15.83% year-over-year, above payment-peer averages
Cross-border transactions and consumer spending remain core growth drivers
P/E of 28.38 reflects a premium for the payment-network franchise
risks_zh: 全球消費若放緩將直接衝擊交易量成長
監管對交換費（interchange）與反壟斷的審查持續存在
高估值對任何成長不及預期的反應較為敏感
risks_en: A slowdown in global consumer spending would directly hit volume growth
Ongoing regulatory scrutiny of interchange fees and antitrust risk
Premium valuation leaves the stock sensitive to any growth disappointment
